prompt.en: In which province are the Badlands, where many dinosaur fossils have been found?
prompt.fr: Dans quelle province se trouvent les Badlands, où l'on a découvert de nombreux fossiles de dinosaures?

explanation.en: Alberta's rugged Badlands hold some of the richest beds of prehistoric fossils and dinosaur finds anywhere.
explanation.fr: Les Badlands accidentés de l'Alberta renferment certains des plus riches gisements de fossiles préhistoriques et de dinosaures qui soient.

source.quote: Alberta has five national parks, including Banff National Park, established in 1885. The rugged Badlands house some of the world’s richest deposits of prehistoric fossils and dinosaur finds.

verification.evidence: Alberta has five national parks, including Banff National Park, established in 1885. The rugged Badlands house some of the world’s richest deposits of prehistoric fossils and dinosaur finds. Alberta is the largest producer of oil and gas
